posts.author: sirenbrian
posts.content_md:
Hi everyone,

It's been very interesting reading the posts in this forum over the last couple of days. I bit the bullet yesterday and ordered some holograms from Royal Holographics in Canada, and am looking forward to beginning my collection. I thought about getting a couple of holograms from Russia, but I'll wait for a bit before moving up to that. I'd like to get one of Yves Gentet's pieces too - those things are just incredible!

If anyone has advice on what to emphasise or avoid in the area of hologram collecting, I'm all ears In the near future I might pick up one of the kits from holokits.com too, and have a crack at making my own - I'd probably start with my little Babylon 5 plastic spaceships!

Nice to meet you all

posts.author: JohnFP
posts.content_md:
Welcome Brian to the wonderful and exciting world of Holography.

I think you should buy any hologram that works for you.

Nice to meet you also. Don't forget to write often and especially about commenting on your newly aquired pieces.

John

posts.author: JohnFP
posts.content_md: PS: I check out your web site this morning and it looks very nice. Good work.

posts.author: Colin Kaminski
posts.content_md:
Welcome aboard. Please let us know what holograms you purchase and how you like them. Also, I would like to hear how you have lit them. We don't often get to buy others holograms so it is good for us to hear about them.

Cheers!
